overview_description.description: WhiteLab Genomics develops a proprietary platform that leverages graph knowledge technology and machine learning to help companies discover and design new genomic therapies. WhiteLab Genomics enables genomic medicine scientists to obtain precise and comprehensive answers to key scientific and technological questions such as optimizing payload and vector design, assessing genotoxicity, and identifying optimal experimental protocols for in vivo and in vitro strategies. Whitelab Genomics guides its clients through the in-silico development phases, allowing them to quickly develop target vectors and payloads while saving valuable time needed to provide patients with access to new genomic therapies.

about_short_description.short_description: WhiteLab Genomics develops digital tools that help gene and cell therapy companies develop cheaper drugs faster.

product.name: ALFRED AI Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform for designing and optimizing genomic medicine candidates across modalities like AAV, lentivirus, and nanoparticles.

product.name: Gene & RNA-based Therapies Pipeline
product.description: A development pipeline for gene and RNA therapies including target receptor identification, viral vector design, and validation.

product.name: Non-Viral Vector Design Pipeline
product.description: A pipeline for designing and validating non-viral delivery vectors for gene therapies, primarily targeting oncology.

product.name: Payload Design Pipeline
product.description: A service for designing and validating therapeutic payloads for gene therapies, with a focus on oncology applications.

product.name: Bioproduction Optimization Platform (OLIVIA)
product.description: A platform using knowledge graphs and large language models to analyze and optimize lentiviral vector bioproduction processes.

identifier.value: Peptide Library Generation and AI-Driven Peptide Design

product.name: Peptide Library Generation and AI-Driven Peptide Design
product.description: In silico generation of synthetic peptide libraries and AI-driven design of peptides for vector engineering and therapeutic targeting.
